label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson Lead
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 21-under through 1 hole, with Scottie Scheffler and Wyndham Clark two shots behind at 19-under in the final round at TPC Craig Ranch.

items.headline: Kim’s Winning Strategy
items.text: Si Woo Kim says he must shoot 6- to 9-under on Sunday to win against Scottie Scheffler, planning an aggressive approach as the course does not favor defensive play.

items.headline: Charlie Woods Misses US Open
items.text: Charlie Woods failed to earn an alternate spot in the 2026 U.S. Open qualifying, reflecting ongoing struggles compared to last season.
